messages:
incident-bot: Pager: multi-gpu job tpprod-42 experiencing a hard hang on tensor/pipeline parallel ranks. Severity: high. @oncall-sam please acknowledge.
megan (eng-runtime): acked. we're seeing repeated CUDA Xid 79 on node gpu-prod-21, then container OOM and kube killed the pod. NCCL logs show 'comms version mismatch' + timeouts.
sam (oncall): looking. marking impacted customers list -> internal ML sandbox + two production tenants (tenant-a, tenant-b).
lia (infra-sre): network flaps on eth0 for gpu-prod-21 at 23:07:12 UTC, kernel dmesg shows "mlx5 link state change" then pod oom at 23:07:54. Node kernel didn't reboot.
raj (eng-ml): pipeline parallel rank 2 and 5 stuck in rendezvous. stacktrace from agent: "ncclCommInitRank failed: unhandled cuda error (77)" and repeated allreduce stalls.
megan (eng-runtime): attaching recent logs (snippets):
```
[23:07:10] NCCL WARN Call to connect timed out
[23:07:11] NCCL ERROR ncclCommInitRank failed: Unhandled cudaError
[23:07:54] containerd: oom kill process pid=12345 cmd=./inference_worker
[23:08:02] kubelet: Killing pod tpprod-42 due to OOM
```
sam (oncall): first mitigation — cordon gpu-prod-21 and drain remaining pods that are not in hot-path. Lia please run drain-prep script.
lia (infra-sre): running `kubectl drain gpu-prod-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m` now. moving non-critical infra.
megan (eng-runtime): can we force communicator teardown for stuck jobs? we have a kill-switch: `redwood-inferctl comm kill --job tpprod-42 --grace 10s`
raj (eng-ml): do it. Also flip runtime fallback to non-NCCL allreduce for affected model family to avoid collective use while node is fluttering. That will reduce throughput but keep requests alive.
sam (oncall): executed `redwood-inferctl comm kill ...` — communicator removed, job re-scheduled. starting canary route to dedicated-hosted for tenant-a/tenant-b.
megan (eng-runtime): started routing rule: `route tpprod-42 -> hosted-compact-1` for 20% of traffic. Observability: latency + error budgets spiked then stabilized.
lia (infra-sre): drain succeeded. gpu-prod-21 remains cordoned. hardware team is investigating intermittent NIC firmware drop. filing ticket HW-5643.
raj (eng-ml): model-level mitigation: disabled tensor-parallel across nodes (force intra-node packing) for this model family until we confirm NCCL stability. Updated rollout config.
sam (oncall): customer-facing status: tenants saw 502/timeout for ~2m while we killed communicator and routed traffic. Communicated via status page: "brief service disruption, mitigation applied".
megan (eng-runtime): next steps: 1) repro with isolated batch to validate firmware patches; 2) run extended collectives test on staging with churn injection; 3) add better NCCL retry/backoff in runtime to avoid hard OOM when link blips.
lia (infra-sre): created postmortem stub: incident/node-fallout-1768004321. Assigning owners: megan, lia, raj.
raj (eng-ml): quick notes: cause likely NIC link flapping causing partial communicator state corruption -> staggered cuda memory usage + OOM on some ranks because others blocked. mitigation path OK for now.
sam (oncall): closing pager. if we get more flaps we'll escalate to oncall-hardware. :thumbsup:
